messages:
jon: Heads up — planning RBAC tweak Wed 02:00 UTC to grant private-deploy-operator Decrypt on customer KMS (kms-priv-eu-1). Need audit + network hardening review before rollout.

maria: Which customers/regions? EU priv tenants only? This touches customer-managed keys and regulatory retention.

jon: Yes EU first. Change is scoped to key kms-priv-eu-1 and role private-deploy-operator. Purpose: bootstrap decrypt for node provisioning.

eli: Critical: we must emit object-level audit entries: principal, key_id, action, request_id, session_id, source_ip, pod_name. Without that we can’t investigate.

priya: Netpol: don’t just namespace allow. Enforce pod selector + egress to proxy ips + mTLS. Also drop CAP_SYS_ADMIN on agent container to reduce exploit risk.

sasha: For replay/exfil: require short-lived session tokens (TTL < 5m) and salt in request metadata. Log the nonce. If we see duplicate nonce -> alert.

sec-bot: FYI CVE-2024-ABCD in kms-agent v2.1.1 allows local escalation; v2.1.3 patches it. Private nodes running 2.1.1.

jon: Ok patching plan needed. Can we do canary + rollback? Also need an emergency revoke path for the role if we see suspicious Decrypts.

maria: Suggested plan:
- Add audit fields (customer_id, session_id, request_id) and ship ingestion change
- Add network policy restricting egress to KMS via jumpbox IPs & require mTLS proxy
- Patch agent v2.1.3 on a single-region canary, run artifacts smoke tests
- Full roll if canary green, otherwise run revoke script to remove Decrypt from role

eli: I'll wire an alert: Pager if Decrypt from unknown IP OR >3 decrypts/min per session OR repeated nonces.

priya: Netpol snippet (operator namespace):
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: operator-restrict-kms-egress
  namespace: operator-ns
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: operator
  policyTypes:
    - Egress
  egress:
    - to:
        - ipBlock:
            cidr: 10.20.30.0/24 # proxy/jumpbox
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 443
```

sasha: I'll build a signed revoke-tool (human approval gate) that removes the role binding from the key policy and emits an audit event. PR by EOD Mon.

jon: Who can be oncall for the Wed 02:00 UTC window? Maria first 2 hours, Eli after that. Priya owns netpol rollout and capability drop. Sasha + sec-bot on standby for revoke.

deploy-bot: Scheduled change rb-20250601-kms-decrypt at 2025-06-01 02:00 UTC. Preflight checks: netpol-lint, audit-schema-tests, agent-upgrade-green.

maria: Smoke tests: decrypt roundtrip, verify audit record exists with customer_id + session_id, check integrity hash.

eli: Also add a daily integrity export with signed manifests to locked bucket (retention 18 months) and index by customer_id for fast queries.

jon: Action items captured. Reconvene Tue 18:00 UTC preflight. If blockers arise, ping here.

sec-bot: Add evidence bucket with tight ACLs for incident artifacts. Make sure retention and access audit are enforced.
